abstract: Pyranose oxidase (POx) is a FAD-dependent oxidoreductase that catalyzes the oxidation of D-glucose to 2-keto-D-glucose with concomitant production of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2). Although POx has been well characterized in several fungi and bacteria, its potential in cancer therapy remains largely unexplored. In this study, we identified a novel pyranose 2-oxidase, designated PsPOx, from the wood-decaying fungus Punctularia strigosozonata through gene mining. The gene was codon-optimized, synthesized, and heterologously expressed in Escherichia coli. The recombinant enzyme was purified and biochemically characterized. Sequence alignment and structural modeling confirmed that PsPOx possesses all conserved features of the GMC superfamily. Kinetic analysis showed that PsPOx exhibits the highest catalytic efficiency (k cat/K m = 85.09 mM-1 s-1) towards D-glucose, with a K m value of 0.8375 mM, indicating a strong substrate affinity. Using the CCK-8 assay, PsPOx demonstrated potent dose-dependent cytotoxicity against three human pancreatic carcinoma cell lines (PANC-1, AsPC-1, and BxPC-3), with IC50 values of 257.8, 195.2, and 176.2 ng mL-1, respectively. However, the IC50 value for the normal human pancreatic epithelial cell line hTERT-HPNE was 195.6 ng mL-1, which was comparable to those for AsPC-1 and BxPC-3, indicating that free PsPOx lacks selectivity between tumor and normal cells. Mechanistic studies revealed that PsPOx treatment increased intracellular and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, induced G0/G1 cell cycle arrest, downregulated Cyclin D1 and PCNA expression, and triggered apoptosis in BxPC-3 cells. These results preliminarily demonstrate that PsPOx possesses antitumor activity in vitro and may serve as a candidate for further development.
key_points_ko: 신규 효소 PsPOx는 D-포도당(D-glucose)에 대해 높은 촉매 효율(k cat/K m = 85.09 mM-1 s-1)과 기질 친화력(K m = 0.8375 mM)을 보였습니다.
인간 췌장암 세포주 PANC-1, AsPC-1, BxPC-3에 대한 IC50 값은 각각 257.8, 195.2, 176.2 ng mL-1이었습니다.
정상 췌장 상피세포주 hTERT-HPNE에 대한 IC50 값은 195.6 ng mL-1로, 암세포에 대한 선택성은 초록에 명시되지 않음(부족함)으로 확인되었습니다.
PsPOx 처리는 BxPC-3 세포에서 활성산소(ROS) 증가, G0/G1 세포 주기 정지, Cyclin D1 및 PCNA 발현 감소를 유도했습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 목재 부후균인 펑크툴라리아 스트리고조나타(Punctularia strigosozonata)에서 신규 피라노스 2-옥시다제(pyranose 2-oxidase) 유전자(PsPOx)를 발굴하고 대장균(Escherichia coli)에서 발현시켜 특성을 분석했습니다. 연구 결과, PsPOx는 세 가지 인간 췌장암 세포주(PANC-1, AsPC-1, BxPC-3)에 대해 용량 의존적인 세포독성을 나타냈습니다. 세포 내 활성산소(ROS) 증가, G0/G1 세포 주기 정지, 그리고 세포 자멸사를 유도하는 기전이 확인되었습니다. 다만 정상 췌장 상피세포주(hTERT-HPNE)와의 세포독성 차이가 적어 종양 세포에 대한 선택성은 부족한 것으로 나타났습니다.
title: Identification and characterization of a novel fungal pyranose 2-oxidase from the Punctularia strigosozonata with potent cytotoxicity against pancreatic carcinoma cell lines
title_ko: 췌장암 세포주에 강력한 세포독성을 보이는 펑크툴라리아 스트리고조나타(Punctularia strigosozonata) 유래 신규 진균 피라노스 2-옥시다제(pyranose 2-oxidase)의 발굴 및 특성 규명
